title: Boone County Planning Commission — Variance (BOA) checklist source availability gap
evidenceScope: The preserved Boone County Planning Commission Applications and Forms page lists Variance (BOA) and links Checklists/Variance_checklist.pdf. On 2026-10-02, two bounded fetch attempts to that exact official URL returned HTTP 403, including a retry using browser-style headers and the official page as referrer; the retry returned text/html rather than a PDF. Therefore no PDF archive, PDF byte count, PDF hash, checklist contents, filing requirements, fees, variance standards, approval procedure, or sign-project applicability are claimed. This record preserves a source-availability gap only; the HTML denial response is not archived as the checklist.
